applies_why: This judge text states a RESULT of DEFENDER WINS and includes a corrected HELD result, so the RESULT rule governs it.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count — weighed (1) retracted reason makes the standing uncountable versus (2) the standing and earlier BROKEN grade still count despite retraction.
why: Because the only CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade was expressly retracted and the challenge standing's stated reason was that same broken link C3, the rule's condition for DEFENDER WINS is not met.
